requirements: R1: Correctly map GitHub PRs closed without merge to the appropriate failed or unmerged internal task state.
R2: Prevent the task-generation loop by correctly handling tasks stuck in 'done' due to sync failures.

slices.title: Patch GitHub PR sync logic for closed without merge status
slices.jtbd: When implementing the status synchronization patch for this epic, I want to fix the state mapping logic for closed PRs, so that the epic's goal of accurate task statuses and preventing generation loops is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task with an associated PR that is closed but not merged
When the sync process evaluates the PR status
Then the task is not marked as done and loop conditions are cleared
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce sync-induced false done states and resulting task generation loops from current rate to 0
